title: Qalam Studio Project Rule Assignment
description: Applies a reusable project rule to a specific Qalam Studio project.

id.description: Stable unique identifier of the rule assignment.

rule_id.description: Identifier of the reusable ProjectRule being applied.

enabled.description: Whether this rule is enabled for the project.

priority.description: Relative priority used when multiple project rules compete or conflict. Higher values take precedence.

parameters.description: Project-specific values required by the referenced rule.

condition.description: Optional project-specific condition controlling when the assignment applies.

notes.description: Optional human-readable explanation or decision context.
